props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, e.g. a lucide icon. Sits beside the title and text.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows a close button; the alert hides itself when it is pressed.

examples.title: tone broadcast · layout banner · dismissible
examples.code:
<Alert tone="broadcast" layout="banner" title="New rate card" dismissible>
  Starts next period.
</Alert>

examples.title: icon
examples.code:
<Alert tone="info" icon={<InfoIcon />} title="Rates change next period">
  New rate card starts on the 1st.
</Alert>

examples.title: tone broadcast · layout banner · appearance solid
examples.code:
<Alert
  tone="broadcast"
  layout="banner"
  appearance="solid"
  title="Maintenance tonight"
>
  The board is read-only from 10pm.
</Alert>
